definition.title: D601-F103-V2 marker mutation build download UART smoke

agentTask.prompt: In the isolated subject worktree only, make one compile-safe UART marker mutation in projects/01_baseline/User/main.c. Print TWO lines: first printf("[D601-F103] CaseRun UART\\r\\n"); to identify the case, then printf("  runId: <runId>\\r\\n"); with the actual runId shown above. The serial terminal may truncate lines beyond 80 characters, so use two printf calls instead of one long line. Put the marker on an execution path after UART/USART initialization so hwpod uart read --port uart1 can observe it; use the existing boot/log initialization flow as context instead of dead code. Prefer the HWPOD workspace text-edit path currently available in the runner; if workspace apply-patch or a higher-level HWPOD edit operation fails, keep using HWPOD/hwpod-node operations and record the exact failure. Do not edit from the Linux runner by cd'ing into the Windows path. After the edit attempt, run exactly these HWPOD checks from the AgentRun workspace with .hwlab/hwpod-spec.yaml: hwpod-ctl spec validate --spec .hwlab/hwpod-spec.yaml; hwpod inspect --spec .hwlab/hwpod-spec.yaml; hwpod build --spec .hwlab/hwpod-spec.yaml; hwpod download --spec .hwlab/hwpod-spec.yaml; hwpod uart read --spec .hwlab/hwpod-spec.yaml --port uart1 --max-bytes 4096. Report the diff summary, build/download returned JSON or job ids, and the raw UART read tail. Success is not required; this case is for collecting HWPOD harness improvement trace data.
constraints: marker 必须包含本次 runId，避免串口旧输出混淆
marker 必须位于 UART/USART 初始化之后的可执行路径中，避免编译下载成功但串口不可见
必须通过 HWPOD workspace/node 链路修改 subjectWorktreePath，不得从 Linux runner 直接 cd 到 Windows 路径
必须尝试 hwpod build、hwpod download 和 hwpod uart read 原入口命令
若修改、编译、下载或串口读取失败，继续保留 trace 和原始错误，不要绕过到非 HWPOD 路径
结果只作为 raw trace/evidence 记录，不做自动评价或自动门禁
